$comment: Conceptos de las cuatro ciudades (referencia de estilo, no se sirven en el mundo). Ver docs/conceptos y la propuesta «Propuestas: las 4 ciudades de xenxo».

images.cero-aerea.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, aerial three-quarter view of a square cyberpunk city district at night floating above a vast neon megacity. A central plaza with a slender 90-meter glowing spire tower, eight city blocks of dark skyscrapers 40 to 60 floors tall with magenta and cyan neon edges, an elevated walkway ring at 8 meters connecting four towers, holographic billboards on the facades, light rain, glowing puddles, ring streets and small parcels with little buildings around the edges. Clean low-poly geometry, readable shapes for virtual reality, cinematic lighting. No text, no logos, no brands, no real people.
images.cero-plaza.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, street-level view of a cyberpunk plaza at night at the foot of a tall glowing spire, rain and neon reflections in puddles, magenta and cyan signs, an elevated pedestrian walkway overhead, a small floating glowing crystal data fragment hovering above the ground as a collectible, a few stylized faceless player avatars exploring. Clean low-poly geometry with neon accents, VR social world look. No text, no logos, no brands, no real people.
images.arcade-aerea.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, aerial three-quarter view of a square futuristic arcade-themed city district at night: towers shaped like giant arcade cabinets with glowing screens and buttons, blue and magenta lights, a giant joystick monument in the central plaza with a huge scoreboard screen, a running race circuit along the ring road marked by glowing checkpoint rings and arrow-shaped boost pads, parcels with small buildings around the edges, floating above a neon megacity. Clean low-poly geometry, readable for VR. No text, no logos, no brands, no real people.
images.arcade-carrera.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, street-level action shot in a neon arcade city: stylized faceless player avatars sprinting through a glowing checkpoint ring on a neon race circuit, arrow-shaped boost pads on the ground, towers shaped like arcade cabinets, a giant screen showing an abstract leaderboard of bars, blue and magenta lights at night. Clean low-poly geometry, VR social world look. No readable text, no logos, no brands, no real people.
images.pixel-aerea.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, aerial three-quarter view of a square retro 8-bit voxel city district at dusk: blocky colorful buildings made of cubes in bright flat colors, square voxel trees and flowers, a central plaza whose floor is an 8 by 8 grid of glowing light tiles, a giant pixel-art heart monument, retro arcade machines around the plaza, ring streets and parcels with small voxel buildings around the edges, floating above a city. Playful, clean, readable for VR. No text, no logos, no brands, no real people, no copyrighted characters.
images.pixel-tablero.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, street-level view of a voxel 8-bit plaza: a group of blocky faceless player avatars jumping onto glowing floor tiles that light up in a simple geometric pattern on an 8 by 8 grid, colorful cube buildings and square trees around, retro arcade cabinets on the edges, a giant pixel heart in the background, cheerful dusk light. Clean voxel style, VR social game. No text, no logos, no brands, no real people, no copyrighted characters.
images.taller-aerea.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, aerial three-quarter view of a square futuristic industrial workshop district at night: large factory halls with sawtooth roofs, construction cranes, robotic arms, warm amber and teal lights, a giant gear monument in the central plaza, a 30 by 30 meter open build zone next to the plaza with half-built colorful block structures and glowing building tools, holographic tutorial panels, ring streets and parcels around the edges, floating above a neon city. images.taller-zona.webp: Stylized 3D game concept art, street-level view inside an open build zone in a futuristic workshop district: stylized faceless player avatars placing glowing colorful blocks, cylinders and light panels to build small structures, a construction crane and robotic arm in the background, floating holographic tutorial panels with simple icons, warm amber and teal lights at night, factory halls around.
